name: PANIC
summary:
It begins with a letter in your mailbox—an ordinary morning that quickly turns strange. Inside, you find a cassette tape and a simple, chilling message: “Remember us.” Curiosity grips you as you play the tape, revealing an address that you can’t ignore.

When you arrive, you discover an abandoned laboratory, untouched for 15 years. Dust covers the floors, machines stand silent, and the air feels heavy with secrets long forgotten. The deeper you explore, the more you realize this place was abruptly abandoned
